page.layout: One block of italic verse in a single column, set in indented stanzas. No running head. A handwritten number at the top right is not printed. A gathering signature stands at the foot right.

p.i: Finibus imperij occiduas adiungere terras: Artibus & pollens numero, ac crudelibus armis, Et quas hinc nuper sensit Germania clades, Tot quando cecidêre Istri flauentis ad vndas Corpora præstantum virtute manuq; virorum: Inq; Deum, gnatúmq; Dei, blasphema superbi Lingua Ducis, solio qua deturbare potenti Nititur æterni æternam patris eicona Christum, Pro Christoq; sui leges atque impia diri Dogmata per totum Mahometi spargere mundum.

Parte alia sæuos ciet ægro in pectore morsus, Germanos agitans nuper discordia fratres, Tempore cognatis quo inter se cernere telis Tentassent, tuáni mecum, fidissima coniux, Cum pietate fides, & præsens gratia, mentes Fraternas, positis odijs, iunxisset amico Fœdere. Tum generi casus & tristia fata, Imperij postquam proceres accendit ad iram, Et procul Vngaricas, offenso Cæsare, in oras Abductum querula deplorans voce maritum Filia, quiq; patrem, placato Cæsare, crebris Expectant parui lacrymis gemituq; nepotes.
Nec satis hæc, nouus ecce nouus dolor vrit amicum Cor mihi, nec placidam membris dat cura quietem Affinis capti, non exspectataq; vincla Admirans lugensq; soror germana mariti.
Denique sollicito varios in corde dolores Excitat, infirmum Christi qui scindit ouile, Hæresεon toto surgens grex impius orbe:

page.notes: Handwritten "154" at top right is not printed and is left out. The signature "a iij" is read from a small mark at the foot and may be "a ij". Words marked with tildes and superscript marks (manuq;, Inq;, gnatúmq;, Christoq;, quiq;, gemituq;, expectataq;, lugensq;) are read as q; for -que. "tuáni" is doubtful. "Hæresεon" should read Hæresæon; the last letter is uncertain.
